notes: Discovery via Google News RSS (gnews/gnews-zh; 18 search calls). Publisher pages could not be resolved: news.google.com redirectors return a JS shell to WebFetch, the batchexecute decode trick failed, and mojeek/ddg returned no publisher URLs, so URLs below are Google News RSS redirector links and every fact is attributed per RSS headline + outlet + date ('per headline') unless stated. Cross-headline caveats: (1) Moonshot AI valuation trajectory in 2026: $20B (TechCrunch, May 7) -> $31.5B pre-money (Wallstreetcn, Jun 30) -> $35B on a >$3.5B F round (Bloomberg/Seeking Alpha, Jul 29) -> $50B pre-IPO target (TechNode/Caixin-tier zh outlets, Jul 22-Aug 5); company denied filing an IPO prospectus (21财经, Aug 6). (2) DeepSeek round reporting conflicts: $7.4B raised at $45B (capacityglobal, May 6), $50B+ (Ventureburn, Jun 17), $59B (Yellow.com, Jun 16) — treat valuation as $45-59B range, all agree the state got special/only voting rights and founder Liang Wenfeng keeps control. (3) Other headline facts not in the 26 sources: record HK IPO lock-up expiry wave (Reuters, Jul 5 2026); Zhipu & MiniMax added to Hang Seng Tech Index + Stock Connect (Moomoo, Apr 28 2026); Hang Seng Tech Index largest-ever overhaul (36Kr, Aug 12 2026); $67B foreign inflow into HK AI names with AI H-shares doubling (21财经, Jul 13 2026); Trump OK'd Nvidia H200 sales to China (Yahoo Finance, Dec 8 2025) with a reported 75K-unit cap + 25% tax (tech-insider.org, Mar 22 2026); StepFun reported burning ¥17.1B in 5 months (新浪财经, May 10 2026, unverified); '无人再议AI六小龙' — the 'AI six tigers' framing is dead as leaders pull away (新浪财经, Aug 3 2026). US-vs-China lens: China funds AI largely without US capital (state $295B plan, Big Fund into DeepSeek, RMB funds) while USD funds in China's primary market shrank 84% in five years; US-investor access narrows from both sides (reverse-CFIUS outbound rules codified Jan 2026; Beijing curbing retail access to US stocks; Zhipu on US Entity List yet Wall Street still courts it).
